findings.claim: The task requires an authenticated GET /v1/cases/{case_id}/processing/documents/{document_id}/events implementation using a trusted identity-to-case authorization seam, document membership checks, the existing bounded audit reader, and safe HTTP error/cache behavior.
findings.observed: The task checkpoint marks the authorized route implementation step incomplete and states that no trusted caller identity/entitlement interface or authenticated synthetic fixture is available. The supplied diff adds only lifecycle routes for /runs, /runs/{run_id}, and /audit that return 403; it does not add the required processing_monitor_routes.py document-events endpoint.
findings.rationale: The canonical goal is end-to-end delivery of the authenticated document-events HTTP foundation. A legitimate authorization prerequisite may explain the blocker, but the required endpoint behavior remains undelivered and cannot satisfy the goal.
findings.required: Provide the owner-approved trusted caller-to-case authorization interface and authorized fixture, then implement and register the document-events route with case/document scope validation, bounded AuditStore.read_document pagination, required response DTO, 400/403-or-masked-404/404/503 behavior, and Cache-Control private, no-store on all responses.

findings.claim: The manifest declares TDD mandatory and the task requires a genuine behavior RED followed by GREEN with the identical focused command in the task-specific red-green proof artifact.
findings.observed: No TDD proof was supplied. The task checkpoint states that RED/GREEN implementation steps remain incomplete and explicitly says no RED/GREEN proof is claimed or manually created.
findings.rationale: With tddRequired=true, the absent required RED/GREEN provenance is independently blocking even though the implementation is also blocked by authorization.
findings.required: After the trusted authorization prerequisite is available, execute the required TDD cycle through the supported TDD skill and provide the task-specific RED/GREEN proof showing the same focused argv and an implementation-specific RED followed by GREEN.

findings.claim: Successful delivery requires actual installation into the intake artifact, guarded in-place deployment to the existing AWS test App Runner target, and bounded authenticated live HTTP verification of the changed document-events route with artifact digest and deployed revision provenance.
findings.observed: The task checkpoint leaves regression/package/deployment/live verification incomplete. The supplied host review records no source or image digest, target revision, recovery/config evidence, authorized synthetic fixture, deployment, or direct live route evidence; Test Gate also has no evidence.
findings.rationale: The canonical task explicitly rejects source-only completion. Without deployment and direct live-function evidence, the required deployed and LIVE-FUNCTION-VERIFIED outcome is not demonstrated.
findings.required: After implementing the authorized route, build and verify the installed audit package/router in the intake artifact, perform a guarded deployment to the verified existing test target, and provide task-local redacted evidence of source/image digest, recovery/config guard, deployed revision/time, authenticated route DTO and pagination assertions, no-store headers, negative auth/scope behavior, and hermetic read-failure-to-503 behavior.
